_readme: All resume text lives here. Edit this file and push to GitHub; the live site updates automatically. The page shows each job's 'key' bullets (3 is best) and hides 'creative', 'highlights', and 'earlier_roles' behind a 'More' link. Work items with "featured": true show first; the rest appear under 'See all work'. The 'intro' block sets the welcome pop-up's text, choices, and delay; answers are saved to the visitor_intros table in Supabase. A job's optional 'since' note (for example 'At Fromm since 2005') shows under its dates. A certificate's 'status' (for example "Completed" or "In progress, Fall 2026") shows next to it; anything not completed is left out of the data Google reads.
_work_help: Each item in 'work' is one card. Optional: 'image' (or 'images': a list of {"src", "alt"} for a small gallery) (a picture you put in public/work/, e.g. "/work/poster.jpg"), 'imageFit': "contain" or "contain-light" (show a logo or screenshot whole on a dark or white background instead of cropping it), 'video' (a YouTube or Vimeo link; YouTube also gives the card its picture), 'link' (any web page), 'role', 'collaborators', 'details'. category must be one of: Design, Video, Storytelling, Marketing, Events, Collaborations, Technology, AI. Featured pieces can also be case studies: add 'challenge', 'approach', and 'outcome' (with 'role' as your part); the open view then shows them as sections.

about: My strength is connecting brand strategy, creative thinking, and marketing with execution, from concept and product development through campaign, production, digital platforms, sales, and customer experience.

I also use AI and generative AI in campaign development, content creation, audience messaging, research, social media marketing, and creative workflows.

work.title: State of Flux
work.summary: Building a brand from the ground up: identity, apparel, retail, e-commerce, and co-branded collaborations with Pinterest, Timbuk2, and SFMOMA.
work.role: Co-Founder & Brand Director: brand strategy, identity, creative direction, product, and marketing, leading a team of 5

A pile of black and gold State of Flux woven labels reading 'Workshop Product'
A model outside a storefront wearing a black and orange Timbuk2 × State of Flux crossbody bag

work.challenge: Launch a new apparel brand in a crowded market and give people a reason to notice it, while I kept my full-time role at Fromm.
work.approach: I built a clear identity and product language, from embroidered tiger caps to woven 'Workshop Product' labels. Then I grew reach through co-branded products, events, and pop-ups with Pinterest, Timbuk2, and SFMOMA, and sold direct to customers and to companies through our store, e-commerce, wholesale, and B2B.
work.outcome: A brand with its own retail store, online shop, and collaborations with three well-known partners. In 2024 I sold my share to my business partner.

work.title: FAZE Apparel
work.summary: From startup to acquisition: brand, products, distribution, trade shows, and our own retail store.
work.role: Co-Founder & Brand Director, leading a team of 5 across design, product, marketing, and sales
work.imageAlt: The FAZE Apparel storefront on a San Francisco street corner, with the FAZE lightning-bolt banner
work.challenge: Turn a new apparel label into a real business: products people wanted, stores willing to carry them, and a brand strong enough to attract a buyer.
work.approach: I led the identity, apparel graphics, lookbooks, photography, and seasonal campaigns, and ran product development from sampling and sourcing to manufacturing and quality control. I designed our trade-show booths in Las Vegas, Miami, Los Angeles, and New York, and designed and built our own retail store.
work.outcome: Grew to 10+ stores and wholesale accounts plus our own store, and built the company through to its acquisition in 2019.

work.title: Fromm Institute: brand & growth
work.summary: Building Fromm's marketing from zero into a multi-channel brand; that marketing grew enrollment 10%.
work.role: Lead brand strategy, creative direction, marketing, and PR; own the $80K marketing budget
work.imageAlt: The Fromm Institute for Lifelong Learning at the University of San Francisco logo in gold on black
work.challenge: Fromm started with no marketing presence, which limited how many new older learners it could reach.
work.approach: I built an integrated program across web, email, print, social, video, and paid digital on Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, and partnered with retirement homes, donor networks, and city agencies to reach new learners.
work.outcome: Because of this marketing, enrollment grew 10%, and Fromm now reaches 1,500+ older learners a year.

work.title: Frommcast

work.role: Built the platform; lead its video and content

work.challenge: Give older adults a way to keep learning from home, beyond the classroom.
work.approach: I built the recording and hybrid-classroom setup, produced the lecture video, and launched it as Frommcast, a branded channel organized by subject on YouTube.
work.outcome: 200+ recorded classes on art, history, science, and more, free for anyone to watch.

work.approach: I use generative AI for campaign development, content, audience messaging, research, and social media. work.outcome: This site is live and shows me who visits and why; the Enrollment Helper is in development.
